look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a locked-in auth provider, tangled SDK wires into components hooks and server code, five provider adapters slotting into one API bar, a swapped adapter beside an unchanged app, and the kavach end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.
